operators.name: concat_dim

parameters.name: x1
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided as per input

parameters.name: x2
parameters.shape: [batch, C, H, W], same as x1 except along dim
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided as per input

returns.shape: same as x1 but concatenated along dim (e.g., [B, 2C, H, W] when dim=1)

semantics: Preserves order: x1 elements first along dim, then x2 elements.
Output must be contiguous as produced by cat.
Supports arbitrary dim within tensor rank.

operators.name: rot90_k1_dims23

returns.layout: view with stride permutation; not a copy

semantics: Rotates 90 degrees counterclockwise in the plane of dims 2 and 3.
Returns a view with strides (s0, s1, s3, s2) if input strides are (s0,s1,s2,s3).
No data movement; output shares storage.
Concatenate x1 and x2 along dimension self.cat_dim.
Output shape doubles along that dimension.
Rotate the concatenated tensor 90 degrees in the plane defined by dims (2,3).
Output shape becomes [B, C, W, H] with stride pattern [s0, s1, s3, s2].
